publishedPurpose: Nightflight Casino DLC English-only front-end demo

licenseScope.generatedAssets: CC0-1.0 dedication to the extent of the project's rights
licenseScope.note: The CC0 dedication covers this project-owned provenance and selection metadata and, for the three project-generated v1 assets, the rights the project can dedicate. It does not expand rights in identities, trademarks, model inputs, or material the project does not own.

process.summary: Three already accepted campaign assets were selected from the public Batch 211 record and used as identity, palette, relationship, wardrobe, and PAWS references for three new policy-compliant campaign assets. Rejected image-generation candidates were not copied, published, or used.
process.generationPolicy: All characters are explicitly fictional adults age 25+; all are fully clothed; no stripping, nudity, lingerie-only presentation, fetish content, sexual activity, or safety-filter evasion.
process.motionDisclosure: The site animates still images with CSS pan, zoom, flare, and scanline layers. It does not claim that the stills are model-generated live-action video.
process.determinism: Each game ID maps to one immutable host, artwork, reciprocal trio-interaction cue, and PAWS action in app/future/casino/demo/nightflight-narrative.mjs; CasinoDemo.tsx only resolves and renders that fixed story, and no random API is used.
